name: subkit
description: Describe recurring work in your own words. AI drafts the workflow, a person approves what it may touch, and it runs in fixed steps with every run on record.
author: Mike Bild

scripts.build:all: bun run build:engine && bun run build:sk
scripts.build:cockpit: bun run gen:cockpit-icons && NODE_ENV=production bunx vite build --config apps/cockpit/vite.config.ts && bun run gen:cockpit
scripts.build:engine: bun run build:clipper && bun run build:cockpit && bun scripts/fetch-embedding-assets.ts && bun build apps/engine/src/index.ts apps/engine/src/embeddings/embedding-worker.ts --compile --root . --external cpu-features --define "process.env.NODE_ENV=process.env.NODE_ENV" --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --outfile dist/engine && ([ "$(uname)" != Darwin ] || sh scripts/codesign-macos.sh dist/engine)
scripts.build:engine:linux-x64: bun run build:clipper && bun run build:cockpit && bun scripts/fetch-embedding-assets.ts && bun build apps/engine/src/index.ts apps/engine/src/embeddings/embedding-worker.ts --compile --root . --external cpu-features --target=bun-linux-x64 --define "process.env.NODE_ENV=process.env.NODE_ENV" --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"${ENGINE_VERSION:-$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')}\"" --outfile dist/engine-linux-x64
scripts.build:sk: bun run build:clipper && bun build apps/sk/src/index.ts --compile --external cpu-features --define "process.env.NODE_ENV=process.env.NODE_ENV" --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --outfile dist/sk && ([ "$(uname)" != Darwin ] || sh scripts/codesign-macos.sh dist/sk)
scripts.check:config-example-drift: bun run gen:config-example && git diff --exit-code subkit.config.example.json
scripts.check:desktop: bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd apps/desktop && bun run --cwd apps/desktop test && bun run --cwd apps/desktop notices:check
scripts.check:embedded-drift: bun run db:gen-embedded && git diff --exit-code apps/engine/src/db/migrations/embedded.ts
scripts.check:llms-txt-drift: bun run gen:llms-txt && git diff --exit-code apps/engine/src/http/llms apps/engine/src/knowledge/seeds apps/engine/src/knowledge/embedded-seeds.ts apps/engine/src/http/docs-images-embedded.ts
scripts.check:openapi-drift: bun run gen:openapi-client && git diff --exit-code packages/cli-core/src/engine-api
scripts.compose:reset: docker compose down -v && sh scripts/ensure-env.sh && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:generate: drizzle-kit generate && bun run scripts/normalize-migration-schema.ts && bun run scripts/prune-migration-snapshots.ts && bun run db:gen-embedded
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:sk && bun run scripts/test-e2e-isolated.ts
scripts.test:flake: for s in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "--- seed=$s ---"; SUBKIT_DETERMINISTIC_SEED=$s bun run test:unit || exit 1; done
scripts.verify:gate:static: bun run check:bun-version && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:recipes && bun run audit:invariants && bun run check:deps-phantom && bun run check:desktop && bun run check:sandbox-tools-drift && bun run check:config-example-drift && bun run check:embedded-drift && bun run check:clipper-drift && bun run check:cockpit-drift && bun run check:release-notes-drift && bun run check:llms-txt-drift && bun run check:docs && bun run check:openapi-drift && bun run test:contract && bun run test:determinism
scripts.verify:gate: bun run verify:gate:static && bun run verify:quality
scripts.verify:gate:release: bun run check:mutation:release && bun run verify:gate:static && bun run check:coverage-floor && bun run test:docker && bun run smoke:surfaces
scripts.verify: bun run check:bun-version && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:recipes && bun run audit:invariants && bun run check:deps-phantom && bun run check:desktop && bun run check:sandbox-tools-drift && bun run benchmark:runtime:smoke && bun run check:config-example-drift && bun run check:embedded-drift && bun run check:clipper-drift && bun run check:llms-txt-drift && bun run check:docs && bun run check:cockpit-drift && bun run check:release-notes-drift && bun run check:openapi-drift && bun run test:contract && bun run test:determinism && bun run scripts/test-files-isolated.ts apps packages scripts && bun run verify:ai && bun run verify:clipper-binaries && bun run test:e2e && bun run verify:quality
scripts.verify:clipper-binaries: bun run build:all && bun run scripts/verify-clipper-binaries.ts
